gate_byte.meaning: 0x00 in the image -> the Q3 0x5C/0x5D domain-14 power route is NOT gated by the image; the gate is a runtime-set flag

xrefs: Ghidra: 3 READ refs to 0x171EC (FUN_0001f218 x2, FUN_0001f2f0 x1); 0 refs to the gate byte 0x172E2 itself -> no writer in the body; the writer is outside the SMU body (PSP/ABL or a runtime path)
consequence: ZD-2's fixed-0xFF write could CLOSE this gate (write 0xFF to SRAM 0xCFD6), but nothing in the image closes it; the domain-14 route is open in the image and the blocker is elsewhere
